name: Typography
purpose: Presents text using the design-system type scale across breakpoints.
scenarios: Render a page heading that scales with viewport width
Display body copy in a readable measure
Show secondary metadata with a caption style

as.description: Semantic element to render; defaults from the variant if omitted.

variants.name: variant
variants.description: Type scale level that maps to size and weight.

states.name: default
states.description: Text rendered at the chosen scale.

antiPatterns: Do not use heading variants only for visual size; keep the document outline semantic.
Do not hardcode colors; use token-provided foreground colors.

a11y.labeling: Headings create the document outline; other text is labelled by context.

responsive.strategy: Font sizes scale with the viewport using clamp() so text stays readable on compact screens.

breakpoints.compact: Heading sizes are capped at the lower clamp bound to avoid overflow.
breakpoints.medium: Heading sizes grow with available space.
breakpoints.large: Heading sizes reach their upper bound.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
